info.title: AIBUS Public Booking API
info.description: Outward-facing AIBUS inventory API. No purchased third-party inventory. Available only with PUBLIC_API_SANDBOX in an isolated aibus_public_sandbox_* database and explicit sandbox inventory grants. No live onboarding. Rate limits: 20 credential exchanges/minute per IP and 120 requests/minute per partner, plus existing API limits. Holds last at most 5 minutes; quotes at most 2 minutes and never beyond the hold. Idempotency keys are partner-global, content-bound and must be reused on uncertain responses; changed content conflicts. Hold-bound recheck is required after holding seats. All 18 functionalities are listed; rescheduling and partner wallets return 501. Cancellation is a full-booking request, not an automatic refund.
